title: New Server.
author: emulsifier
body: YES! We are officially done migrating to the new server. Some of you may still be pointing to the old box until your dns entries get updated. If I see any new comments come in over there I’ll be sure to move them to the new database. Thanks for reading guys, and for submitting us to reddit. Without you I wouldn’t have had reason to kick that old piece of shit. Keep it coming!
